enforced.claim: A red job blocks the merge
enforced.mechanism: ruleset "Green Main" requires `gate`; `gate` runs last with `if: always()` and needs the 7 jobs `lint-test`, `Golden Vectors`, `Python/Rust Parity`, `Kani BMC`, `Mutation Testing`, `Examples`, `Contract Validation`
enforced.red_when: any needed job failed, was cancelled or was skipped
enforced.plant: a failing step in Kani BMC, not the first job: lint-test green, kani red, `gate` red, merge BLOCKED
enforced.limit: Org admins may bypass the ruleset ("always"), and the account that merges here is one. No merge used it: every blocking check was green before each merge ([audit](docs/ontology-conformance.md#findings))

unplanted.claim: Each example receipt conforms to its closed SHACL shape
unplanted.mechanism: `pv lint --gate shapes` over 12 shapes and 12 focus nodes (the 11 example receipts and this table); the Examples job diffs each receipt against `evidence/examples/`
unplanted.red_when: any shape violation, or a receipt that differs from its tracked evidence
unplanted.limit: Checks the 11 examples on their fixed inputs, not the library on other inputs

unplanted.claim: The ONT-G contracts gate runs every step
unplanted.mechanism: `scripts/contracts_gate.sh`: 6 steps, each RUN with its own status
unplanted.red_when: any step fails; the later steps still run
unplanted.limit: pv is the instrument: its defects pass through ([aprender#4531](https://github.com/paiml/aprender/issues/4531), [aprender#4521](https://github.com/paiml/aprender/issues/4521))

unplanted.claim: README.md is generated: every byte comes from `docs/README.md.in` and the ontology
unplanted.mechanism: `scripts/readme_sync.sh --check` regenerates the whole file and compares bytes; `scripts/example_links.sh` checks every example link
unplanted.red_when: any README byte differs from the regenerated file; a link whose target does not say what the link claims
unplanted.limit: The prose in `docs/README.md.in` is written by hand: the gate proves the README matches it, not that the prose is true

unplanted.claim: Every claim in this table conforms to its closed SHACL shape
unplanted.mechanism: this table is rendered from `evidence/enforcement/claims.json`, closed by `contracts/enforcement-claims-v1.yaml`; the generator also checks each claim's job against `scripts/ci_gate.sh`
unplanted.red_when: an enforced claim with no plant run; an advisory check presented as enforced; a claim whose job `gate` does or does not need contrary to its class
unplanted.limit: The shape checks that a plant run is recorded, not what the run showed: the run itself is the receipt

unplanted.claim: Proof levels only rise; phantom Kani references only fall
unplanted.red_when: a level drops, or phantoms exceed 28
unplanted.limit: Levels today: 1 at L1, 22 at L3. pv credits a declared harness toward L3 without checking that it exists

unplanted.claim: Bounded properties hold for every input within the bound
unplanted.limit: BOUNDED: unwind 4 to 9, so no loop runs more than 8 times. Nothing is proved beyond the bound. Every declared harness exists for 12 of 22 contracts; 28 declared harnesses are phantoms ([#6](https://github.com/paiml/rust-mdipierro-nlib/issues/6))

unplanted.claim: Pre- and postconditions hold at runtime
unplanted.mechanism: 10 `contract_pre_*!`/`contract_post_*!` macros, written by hand in `build.rs`, at 11 call sites
unplanted.red_when: an assertion panics in a debug or test build
unplanted.limit: They expand to `debug_assert!`: release builds are NOT checked at runtime. `quicksort: input exists` (`len < usize::MAX`) can never fail

unplanted.claim: The tests catch changes to the code a PR touches
unplanted.red_when: a mutant on a changed line survives
unplanted.limit: Code the PR does not touch is not re-checked

unplanted.claim: Values match the golden vectors from Python nlib
The Rust values match Python nlib run live
unplanted.mechanism: `tests/falsify_parity.py` runs Di Pierro's nlib.py at a pinned commit against `cargo run --example parity`
unplanted.red_when: any value differs beyond its tolerance
unplanted.limit: Parity cannot catch a bug the two implementations share

not_enforced.claim: An equation is true on every input of an exact model (L4)
not_enforced.mechanism: Lean 4: 0 equation(s) cite a sorry-free, in-tree Lean theorem ([#5](https://github.com/paiml/rust-mdipierro-nlib/issues/5))
not_enforced.red_when: nothing: no required check builds Lean yet
not_enforced.limit: No contract is above L3 yet

not_enforced.claim: The whole library survives mutation testing
not_enforced.mechanism: the full `cargo mutants` sweep on `main`, a step with `continue-on-error: true`
not_enforced.red_when: never blocks: it runs after the merge
fails today, and `gate` does not need it
not_enforced.limit: Its failures are governance (branch protection needs an admin, `deny.toml`, `build.rs`, roadmap and spec schema, TDG), not contract enforcement
